title: Analyses of the mechanism and therapeutic targets of senescence related genes in ischemic stroke with multi-omics approach

evidence_spans.quote: Ischemic stroke (IS) affects 11 million people annually

scope_reviewer.uncertainty_reason: The abstract frames genes as senescence-associated/aging-related but does not state that a senescent state or another aging construct was measured or analyzed; it also claims multi-omics while explicitly supporting only expression-based transcriptomic analysis.
scope_reviewer.concise_rationale: Original empirical ischemic-stroke analysis. Aging relevance is unresolved because senescence is used as a gene modifier rather than an analyzed state. The generic multi-omics claim with one named molecular layer makes multi-omics status unclear.

evidence_spans.quote: machine learning-driven Weighted Gene Co-expression Network Analysis (WGCNA) identified core genetic signatures
A strong positive correlation (r = 0.72, p < 0.001) between NFE2L2 and PTGS2 expression was observed.

causal_design_reviewer.concise_rationale: The report applies differential-expression, co-expression/network, biomarker, and correlation analyses, with RT-qPCR confirmation, but no applied intervention, instrument, temporal identification, formal mediation, or directed causal model.
